title: Ayodhya Tour
overview: Experience the divine aura of Ayodhya, the birthplace of Lord Rama. This thoughtfully curated tour takes you through the most sacred temples, ancient ghats, and spiritual landmarks that define the spiritual heart of India.
highlights: Darshan at the grand Ram Mandir
Evening Aarti at Saryu River Ghat
Visit to Hanuman Garhi and Kanak Bhawan
Guided spiritual walk through ancient Ayodhya

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ayodhya & Evening Aarti
itinerary.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your premium hotel. In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Saryu River Aarti, a deeply spiritual experience with hundreds of floating diyas.

itinerary.title: Temple Trail & Ram Mandir Darshan
itinerary.description: Early morning visit to the magnificent Ram Janmabhoomi Temple. Later, explore Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, and other significant sites associated with the Ramayana.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After a wholesome breakfast, spend some free time for local shopping before departing with divine blessings.

inclusions: AC transportation for all transfers and sightseeing
